𝗦𝗛𝗔𝗞𝗘𝗘𝗟 𝟵𝟯 & 𝟵𝟳! 😮🇵🇰

Pakistan v Sri Lanka 1st Test drawn in Rawalpindi.
PAK 434/9d & 284/8d, SL 446. Saud Shakeel missed a ton twice; debutant Saqib Khan took 7/130.

Test 2 on Tuesday. Who wins? 👇
